The Amelia Island Cabana Shift Dress features 3/4 sleeves and a classic 35" shift silhouette, making it ideal if you want a little extra arm coverage and a versatile look that transitions effortlessly from day to night.
The Flora Short Sleeve Shift Dress offers a lighter short-sleeve silhouette, ultra-soft breathable UPF 50+ fabric, and functional side pockets for easy, comfortable daily wear at a slightly lower price point.
If you prefer extra coverage and a classic 3/4 sleeve look, the Amelia Island Cabana Shift Dress is a great pick. If you want lightweight short sleeves with convenient pockets at a great value, the Flora Short Sleeve Shift Dress may be the better fit for you!
